phases.name: The one decision learns which Teams work a Feature

steps.name: A dependency whose two ends are not one Team is not one this slice acts on
criteria: FeatureDependencyFacts carries the Teams that work the Feature, read off what the caller already loaded.
A new reason says the wait crosses a Team, decided in the one policy and nowhere else (KPI-5).
It is the last reason considered, so a cross-Team edge that is also in a loop still reports the loop.
Honoured means exactly one Team works the Feature waiting and the same one Team works the Feature waited on.

steps.name: The row says the wait crosses a Team, in the instance's own words
criteria: The closed reason set on the frontend matches the backend's.
The sentence names the Feature waited on and says the wait is not in the forecast.
It does not use the word this product reserves for work held up right now.

phases.name: The one decision is handed the instance's real licence answer

steps.name: Name the seam that supplies the licence answer
criteria: DependencyFacts.About takes the licence answer as an argument; nothing hard-codes it any more.
NotLicensed replaces only a verdict that would otherwise have been honoured, so an unlicensed reader is never told a purchase would move a date it would not move.
A Portfolio that has set its dependencies aside still reads as set aside, licensed or not.

steps.name: Re-cut the two rules that forbid the licence read this slice must add
criteria: The replacement invariant is named, not deleted: the licence reaches the decision's input and nothing downstream of it re-reads the licence.
Reading what a Feature waits on still costs nothing - no route that hands out the count is charged for.

steps.name: One line tells an operator the dates ignore real dependencies
criteria: One aggregated line per Portfolio, naming the Teams whose dependencies were left out - not one per edge, not one per Feature.
Silent on a licensed instance and silent for a Portfolio that has set its dependencies aside, because both present an empty set of withheld waits.
It rides inside the reporting the refresh round already does rather than adding a line beside it.

steps.name: The unlicensed hint reads on the row and in the list
criteria: The sentence names what is withheld, says the wait is not accounted for in the dates, and says a premium licence is what accounts for it.
It does not use the word this product reserves for work held up right now.

phases.name: The forecast waits for what a Feature waits on

steps.name: Give the forecast one port to ask, and re-cut the rule that forbade it
criteria: The forecast reaches one port and the answer it returns, and nothing else this epic added - not the policy, not the circle walk, not the licence.
AtMostOnePlace tightens to exactly one, which is what the weaker form was waiting for.

steps.name: A Feature waiting on one that is not finished is left out of the day's eligible set
criteria: One predicate at one call site: the eligible set narrows and the WIP window slides down to the Features below.
Readiness is derived from the remaining counts that already reset per trial - no new per-trial state.
A day on which everything eligible is waiting is an idle day: the delivery drawn for it is discarded, not carried forward, and no Feature-pick draw is consumed.
With no wait recorded anywhere, the run consumes exactly the draws it consumed before, in the same order.

phases.name: The scenarios that decide whether the epic was worth building

steps.name: Milestone 1 as executable specifications
criteria: Every date is read off a forecast that really ran, against a pinned starting number.
Each scenario asserting a date did not move carries a Feature in the same run whose date did move.
AC-5.2 compares two runs of the same build against the same starting number, so it needs no stored gold number.

phases.name: Say what was decided and what it cost

steps.name: Record the verdicts, the re-cut seams and the scenario this slice cannot carry
criteria: The learning hypothesis carries a verdict.
The multi-Team blocker scenario is moved to slice 02 with the reason it cannot be observed while each Team runs its own trials.
